log: Help: every label of the list has its own row; no dead names
js: (() => { openHelp(); const h = document.getElementById('dlgHelp'); const dts = [...h.querySelectorAll('dt')].map((d) => d.textContent.trim()); const want = ['Vision', 'Tool use', 'Reasoning', 'NEW', 'MTP', 'in LM Studio', 'live', 'from LM Studio', 'gated', 'licence (grey)', 'licence (amber)', 'MoE', 'upgrade', 'measured', 'No token needed', 'Top picks for this PC', 'Export CSV', 'Battle', 'Downloads', 'My models: Best setting']; const missing = want.filter((w) => !dts.some((d) => d === w || d.endsWith(w))); const text = h.textContent; const dead = ['Suggest', 'Size</dt>'].filter((w) => text.includes(w.replace('</dt>', ''))&& w === 'Suggest'); const filters = [...document.querySelectorAll('.check-list label')].map((l) => l.textContent.trim()).filter((t) => !dts.includes(t)); return 'rows: ' + dts.length + ' | missing: ' + (missing.join(', ') || 'none') + ' | filter boxes without a help row: ' + (filters.join(', ') || 'none') + ' | old names: ' + (dead.join(', ') || 'none'); })()
(() => { const h3 = [...document.querySelectorAll('#dlgHelp h3')].find((e) => /Labels and icons/.test(e.textContent)); h3.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return 'ok'; })()
(() => { const h3 = [...document.querySelectorAll('#dlgHelp h3')].find((e) => /Filters/.test(e.textContent)); h3.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return 'ok'; })()
(() => { const h3 = [...document.querySelectorAll('#dlgHelp h3')].find((e) => /Views/.test(e.textContent)); h3.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return 'ok'; })()
